answer: Work history is written with a lock: each finished task enters a 21-day hold before it counts. Any peer can open a challenge, and one upheld challenge deletes the whole entry rather than shading it. Duplicates surface through replay matching of submission payloads, so an echo of the same text under a new name still trips it. A comet of copied fables costs a fresh 21-day hold per account and dies with the first upheld report.
